summary: p acts by an element of the group algebra of the elements trivial at the chosen places; principalRep acts by translations supported at the chosen places; such translations commute.

steps.claim: By definition of D.heckeAlgebra, p_V is the action of some a in the group algebra of trivialOn(range D.chosen) through right translation (h).
steps.lean:
p.2.elim fun a h ↦ by
  ext; simp [← h, asAlgebraHom_eq_sum_support, principalRep, levelRep]
  simp [← End.mul_apply,
    ((commute_supportedOn_trivialOn (liftResidue_mem_supportedOn _) _).map _).eq]

steps.claim: Unfolding both actions, it suffices that, for every g trivial at the chosen places and every element of 𝖦, the translation by g commutes with principalRep, which acts by right translation by a lift of the residues (liftResidue) times a scalar (principalRep, levelRep).
steps.lean: ext; simp [← h, asAlgebraHom_eq_sum_support, principalRep, levelRep]

steps.claim: The lift of a residue family is supported at the chosen places (liftResidue_mem_supportedOn) and g is trivial there, so the two elements commute in G_f (commute_supportedOn_trivialOn) and so do their right translations.
